title: Reconcile stale PRD status before enqueueing
description: Detect PRDs that are marked pending but appear already implemented, completed, archived, or broad umbrella strategy documents. Ralph should require a narrow remaining-delta PRD before starting duplicate work.

userStories.title: Detect non-executable or stale PRDs
userStories.description: Refuse or warn on PRDs that are umbrella strategy docs, already completed according to frontmatter, or clearly stale against task history.
acceptanceCriteria: Completed or archived PRDs are not auto-ingested.
Umbrella PRDs require an explicit allow flag or executable frontmatter.
The refusal message tells the operator to create a narrow delta PRD.

userStories.title: Surface dependency and duplicate risks
userStories.description: Before enqueueing a batch, show missing dependencies, active duplicates, completed duplicates, and broad write-surface overlap.
acceptanceCriteria: batch-start reports skipped, blocked, and enqueued PRDs separately.
doctor can check a PRD folder for stale status and duplicate active tasks.
The default path remains conservative and does not start ambiguous work.

userStories.title: Validate against ez4ielts-style Markdown task indexes
userStories.description: Use task index and frontmatter evidence to keep Markdown PRD status aligned before work enters the queue.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests include pending, completed, in_progress, and non-executable Markdown samples.
Status reconciliation does not mutate user docs unless an explicit command is added.
